title: Web Hosting Plans Allowance on Restore-Day Extensions (Domain Registrations)
content:
Domain Registrations gives a plan allowance on a restore-day extension where a Web Hosting Plans plan is active for the domain; the restore-day plan allowance is one of the restore-day credits.

## Terms

The restore-day plan allowance, one of the restore-day credits, is:

- where the active Harborline hosting plan whose primary domain is this domain is a Harborline Business, Harborline Cloud 4 or Harborline Cloud 8 plan: the amount by which the TLD's renewal price exceeds its first-year registration price, for each restore-day year, that amount being never less than USD 0.75 for each restore-day year, also where the renewal price does not exceed the registration price;
- where that active plan is a Harborline Starter, Harborline Plus or Harborline Pro plan: the flat USD 0.75 once for the order, whatever the TLD's prices and however many restore-day years are ordered;
- where no such plan is active: nothing.

## Hypothetical calculations (prices invented for illustration)

1. Active Harborline Business plan, renewal price USD 40.00, registration price USD 30.00, 3 restore-day years: USD 10.00 for each year, USD 30.00 in all.
2. Active Harborline Cloud 8 plan, renewal price USD 30.50, registration price USD 30.00, 3 restore-day years: the difference of USD 0.50 is below USD 0.75, so USD 0.75 for each year, USD 2.25 in all.
3. Active Harborline Cloud 4 plan, renewal price USD 29.00, registration price USD 30.00, 2 restore-day years: USD 0.75 for each year, USD 1.50.
4. Active Harborline Pro plan, any prices, 6 restore-day years: USD 0.75 once.
5. No active plan for the domain: nothing.
